name: WF-03: Computer Vision Disease Detection Engine

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO cv_analysis_reports (workflow_execution_id, analysis_type, image_size_bytes, detections, bwd_results, ai_interpretation, confidence_avg, status, session_id, created_at)
VALUES (
  '{{ $json.request_id }}',
  '{{ $json.analysis_type }}',
  {{ $json.image_info.size_bytes }},
  '{{ JSON.stringify($json.detections).replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ JSON.stringify($json.bwd_analysis || {}).replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ $json.ai_diagnosis.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  {{ $json.detections.avg_confidence_pct }},
  'success',
  '{{ $json.session_id }}',
  NOW()
);

meta.description: Computer Vision Engine - parallel Roboflow + BWD analysis with Gemini AI interpretation
